name: Outback Steakhouse Plain Baked Sweet Potato (Flesh Only)
whyItWorks: Tender baked sweet potato interior flesh. Soft, moist soluble starch with gentle beta-carotene that provides easy calories during recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Baked sweet potato completely plain and dry—NO brown sugar cinnamon butter, NO honey, NO honey butter.' Discard the outer skin and eat only the soft orange flesh.
